companions.description: One entry per companion, each with its own dusha server and AstrBot platform or config profile. The first entry that matches a chat serves it. Leave platform_id and config_profile empty to disable an entry.

label.description: Name for this companion in this settings page only. It is never sent to the server and never affects routing.

gateway_url.description: Dusha server URL for this companion.

platform_id.description: Exact AstrBot platform ID allowed to use this companion. Run /sid on the selected bot and copy Bot ID. Empty matches every platform when config_profile is set.

config_profile.description: AstrBot config profile ID or name allowed to use this companion. Empty matches every profile. Leave both this and platform_id empty to disable this companion.

harness.description: Harness name sent to the server. Keep it unique per companion, because the server keys proactive events by this name. After a rename, events queued under the old name are orphaned and this companion stops receiving them.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between proactive event polls. Values below 5 clamp to 5.

proactive_enabled.description: Poll and send proactive events for this companion.

request_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for one server response. Values below 1 clamp to 1.
